Hi Olivia — thanks for the docs and the clear asks. Quick answers below and a proposed ops handshake.

- Invoice originator: Redwood can emit invoices from billing@redwood-inference.com. The billing "remit-to" will remain Redwood Inference, Inc., with our Luxembourg VAT id on EU invoices.
- Delivery channel: We support portal push (preferred for automated ingest). We can also send a one-off emailed copy to accounts@greenlinehealth.com for the first invoice. After that, we'll default to portal only unless you request continues email copies.
- VAT / reverse charge: We can include the reverse-charge annotation in the invoice metadata; we'll need Greenline's VAT ID to populate the reverse-charge field.

Proposed handoff steps (high level):
1) Greenline confirms VAT ID and whether they want emailed copies beyond the first invoice.
2) Redwood creates an AP mapping: remit email = billing@redwood-inference.com; invoice XML will include VAT tag and a reference to GF-4319.
3) Connor will schedule the portal push cadence and deliver a test invoice to your sandbox ingest endpoint.
4) On success, we set production push and (if requested) enable email copies on T+0 for the first invoice.

Connor and Ben, can you pick up items 2–3? I'll follow up with the test window and a short checklist for Greenline's AP team.

Best,
